historical_load.source_name: IESO Hourly Zonal Demand Report, Southwest zone (observed, 2021-2025)

scale.note: No observed Waterloo-only hourly series exists. The observed hourly SHAPE of IESO's Southwest zone (which contains Waterloo) is scaled so its 5-year peak equals 78 MW, giving a demo-zone-sized baseline. Result is DERIVED, not observed Waterloo demand.

capacity.source_note: Hackathon assumption. No public source provides a real local capacity for this demo zone.
